audit_reproduction.bca_note: BCa uses a delete-one-cluster jackknife for the acceleration constant, which is the correct resampling unit for company-clustered observations.

monte_carlo_error.note: With B replicates the Monte Carlo standard error of a 2.5% percentile is approximately sqrt(p(1-p)/B) / density. At B=20000 this is roughly an order of magnitude smaller than at E4's B=5000, so E4's interval endpoints carry more simulation noise than the audit's.

original_e4_published.percentile_convention: nearest rank: index = floor((n-1) * p), clamped (E4 _percentile)
